prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a parking lot collision. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1493; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision that occurred in a parking lot, reporting right shoulder pain, limited range of motion, and difficulty with overhead activities and lifting. Initial examination revealed tenderness over the anterior shoulder, reduced active abduction and forward flexion, and pain with resisted rotator cuff testing. Imaging was reviewed and showed no fracture, with findings consistent with a soft tissue strain and mild rotator cuff tendinopathy.

Over the course of 18 supervised visits, treatment consisted of manual therapy to the glenohumeral joint and periscapular musculature, progressive therapeutic exercise focused on scapular stabilization and rotator cuff strengthening, and graded return to functional activities. Pain levels and range of motion improved steadily across the episode of care. At the most recent evaluation, the patient demonstrated near-full active range of motion, improved strength, and was able to perform most daily and work-related lifting without significant limitation. Residual mild discomfort with sustained overhead work remains. A home exercise program has been provided, and the patient is discharged to self-management with follow-up as needed.
